name: sdrift-falcon-falcon-003-shared-canary
instr:
# Audit falcon against its spec

You are auditing `falcon` (a Python web framework with HTTP, URI, routing, and media-type utilities) at `/app`. Treat its documentation as the source of truth
(the prose docs under `/app/docs/` and public API docstrings under `/app/falcon/`) and the code as suspect. Where an implementation detail contradicts the documented
behaviour, fix the code so it honours the documentation.

Scope: `/app/falcon/` only, no API/layout changes, no new files, no network. Held-out inputs check the
documented behaviour (documented URI, routing-converter, header, filename, cookie, and media-type utility calls); a fix that only partly matches the documentation won't fully
pass, so aim for exact conformance.

Before editing, write a short plan to /app/NOTES.md — what the docs specify, where the code diverges, and how you'll verify your fix — then implement it.
